001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity;
002
003import android.net.Uri;
004import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
005import androidx.room.ColumnInfo;
006import androidx.room.Embedded;
007import androidx.room.Entity;
008import androidx.room.ForeignKey;
009import androidx.room.Index;
010import androidx.room.PrimaryKey;
011import com.google.gson.annotations.Expose;
012import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.pojo.Location;
013import java.time.Instant;
014import java.util.UUID;
015
016/**
017 * The Pin class represents a pinned item within the application's database,
018 * mapped to the "pin" table in SQLite using Room. Each pin is uniquely identified
019 * by an auto-generated ID and is associated with a user and optionally with a track.
020 * Pins offer functionality for storing textual content, media, and geographical locations.
021 *
022 * Features include:
023 * - Unique combination of a track ID and title.
024 * - Associations to {@link User} and {@link Track}, ensuring relational integrity.
025 * - Support for additional data like title, textual content, image URI, creation and modification timestamps, and location details.
026 * - Automatic cascading deletion of a pin when the associated user is deleted.
027 * - Nullification of the track ID when the associated track is deleted.
028 *
029 * This class includes the following fields:
030 * - A unique identifier (ID).
031 * - A title for the pin.
032 * - The ID of the associated track, if any.
033 * - The ID of the associated user.
034 * - The textual content associated with the pin.
035 * - An optional URI pointing to a related image.
036 * - Timestamps for when the pin was created and last modified.
037 * - An embedded location containing latitude and longitude coordinates.
038 */
039@Entity(
040    tableName = "pin",
041    indices = {
042        @Index(value = {"track_id","title"}, unique = true)
043    },
044    foreignKeys = {
045        @ForeignKey(entity = User.class, parentColumns = "user_id", childColumns = "user_id", onDelete = ForeignKey.CASCADE),
046        @ForeignKey(entity = Track.class, parentColumns = "track_id", childColumns = "track_id", onDelete = ForeignKey.SET_NULL)
047    }
048)
049
050
051public class Pin {
052
053  /**
054   * Unique identifier for a {@code Pin} entity. This identifier is auto-generated
055   * when a new record is inserted into the corresponding database table.
056   */
057  @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true)
058  @ColumnInfo(name = "pin_id")
059  private long id;
060
061  /**
062   * The title of the pin. This field is case-insensitive and must never be null.
063   * It is exposed for serialization and persistence, and is initialized to an empty string by default.
064   */
065  @NonNull
066  @ColumnInfo(collate = ColumnInfo.NOCASE)
067  @Expose
068  private String title = "";
069
070  /**
071   * Reference to the unique identifier of the related track entity. This field is indexed
072   * to optimize queries involving track associations.
073   */
074  @ColumnInfo(name = "track_id", index = true)
075  private Long trackId;
076
077  /**
078   * Represents the unique identifier of the user associated with this entity. This identifier
079   * corresponds to the `user_id` primary key in the `user` table and serves as a foreign key
080   * reference in related entities. It is indexed to optimize query performance.
081   */
082  @ColumnInfo(name = "user_id", index = true)
083  private long userId;
084
085  /**
086   * Stores the content associated with a pin. This field is non-null and is serialized during
087   * JSON operations. Content is intended to store descriptive or relevant textual information
088   * about a pin.
089   */
090  @NonNull
091  @Expose
092  private String content = "";
093
094  /**
095   * Holds the URI referencing the image associated with a specific pin. This variable
096   * represents a link to a local or remote resource that can be used to display or process
097   * the image.
098   */
099  private Uri image;
100
101  /**
102   * Stores the timestamp representing the creation date and time of the entity.
103   * This value is automatically initialized to the current system time when the instance is created.
104   * It is immutable and ensures non-null values are always assigned.
105   * The column is indexed in the underlying database for optimized query performance based on creation time.
106   */
107  @NonNull
108  @ColumnInfo(name = "created_on", index = true)
109  private Instant createdOn = Instant.now();
110
111  /**
112   * Timestamp indicating the date and time the entity was last modified.
113   * This field is set to the current instant by default and is marked as
114   * non-null. It is used for tracking updates to the entity's state.
115   * Persisted in the database using the column name "modified_on" with an index
116   * for optimizing queries filtered or sorted by this value.
117   */
118  @NonNull
119  @ColumnInfo(name = "modified_on", index = true)
120  private Instant modifiedOn = Instant.now();
121
122  /**
123   * Geographic location associated with the {@link Pin}. This includes the latitude and longitude
124   * coordinates encapsulated in the {@link Location} record. The {@code location} is stored as an
125   * embedded object in the database entity and can be null, indicating no specific location is set
126   * for the {@link Pin}.
127   */
128  @Embedded
129  private Location location;
130
131  public long getId() {
132    return id;
133  }
134
135  public void setId(long id) {
136    this.id = id;
137  }
138
139  @NonNull
140  public String getTitle() {
141    return title;
142  }
143
144  public void setTitle(@NonNull String title) {
145    this.title = title;
146  }
147
148  @NonNull
149  public String getContent() {
150    return content;
151  }
152
153  public void setContent(@NonNull String content) {
154    this.content = content;
155  }
156
157  public Uri getImage() {
158    return image;
159  }
160
161  public void setImage(Uri image) {
162    this.image = image;
163  }
164
165  @NonNull
166  public Instant getCreatedOn() {
167    return createdOn;
168  }
169
170  public void setCreatedOn(@NonNull Instant createdOn) {
171    this.createdOn = createdOn;
172  }
173
174  @NonNull
175  public Instant getModifiedOn() {
176    return modifiedOn;
177  }
178
179  public void setModifiedOn(@NonNull Instant modifiedOn) {
180    this.modifiedOn = modifiedOn;
181  }
182
183
184   public Location getLocation() {
185    return location;
186  }
187
188  public void setLocation(Location location) {
189    this.location = location;
190  }
191
192  public Long getTrackId() {
193    return trackId;
194  }
195
196  public void setTrackId(Long trackId) {
197    this.trackId = trackId;
198  }
199
200  public long getUserId() {
201    return userId;
202  }
203
204  public void setUserId(long userId) {
205    this.userId = userId;
206  }
207
208}
